text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was bitterly disappointed after my last race,
but today, I will definitely show you I can win.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete.
We have done everything within our power.
choice_data_list: Let's take a deep breath to psych ourselves up one last time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. That really got me fired up again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is almost the appointed time.
—Auf geht's!
